Market today: Rising Treasury yields are the main driver, making risk-free assets more appealing. This typically pressures growth and tech stocks, especially those with higher valuations, which is key for your concentrated book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-32.15%) and SPAL (-34.4%) are leveraged ETFs in "SELL" status, showing deep drawdowns. Trading on margin amplifies these losses, making them critical to address.

Watch: Monitor Treasury yield movements closely. Any further increases could continue to weigh on your tech-heavy portfolio. Also, keep an eye on your leveraged positions for further decay.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your leveraged losers, as rising yields create a tougher environment for your concentrated tech portfolio.
plays: SOXL: With a -32.15% loss and "SELL" status, consider trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF to reduce risk.
SPAL: This leveraged ETF is down -34.4% and marked "SELL". Review your stop at 21.38; if it breaks, consider exiting.
SMH: The scanner suggests "ACCUMULATE" for SMH at 606.64-606.04. If you want to add to chip exposure, this could be an entry.
